Overview

A spacious two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment located in M1, Manchester, offering contemporary city-centre living and an attractive investment opportunity. With reservations available from just £2,500, a projected 6% gross rental yield, 5% net rental yield and strong local rental demand, this property is ideal for investors seeking a high-quality home with excellent long-term potential.

Key Features:

• 2-Bedroom, 2-Bathroom Apartment
• Reserve from £2,500
• 15% on Exchange
• 6% Gross Rental Yield
• 5% Net Rental Yield
• Strong Rental Demand
• Premium M1 Manchester Location

The Investment

This two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment presents an excellent investment opportunity, offering a projected 6% gross rental yield and 5% net rental yield.

Investors can reserve from just £2,500, followed by 15% payable on exchange, providing an accessible investment structure with attractive projected rental returns and strong long-term potential.

The Location

Situated in M1, Manchester, the development benefits from a premium and highly sought-after city-centre location, offering excellent access to major employment hubs, Manchester's business district, universities, shopping destinations, restaurants, bars and entertainment venues.

M1 benefits from strong rental demand, particularly from professionals and students seeking convenient city-centre accommodation. Excellent transport connections and Manchester's continued economic growth and regeneration further enhance the area's appeal to both residents and investors.

The Apartments

The development offers contemporary two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartments designed for modern city living. Each home features stylish interiors, spacious layouts and high-quality finishes, creating desirable living spaces for professionals, sharers, families and investors.

The two-bathroom layout provides additional convenience and privacy, making these apartments particularly attractive to sharers and professional tenants.

The Development

Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, the development offers high-quality apartments in a premium M1 location. Residents benefit from a range of premium on-site amenities, including:

• Fully Equipped Gym
• Residents’ Lounge
• Co-Working Spaces
• Concierge Service
• Rooftop Garden

The combination of contemporary design, premium resident facilities, excellent city-centre connectivity and strong rental demand creates a desirable living environment for residents while providing investors with an attractive opportunity in Manchester's growing property market.

Why Invest?

M1 offers strong potential for property investors, supported by Manchester's continued economic growth, regeneration and high demand for quality city-centre rental accommodation.

Investment highlights include:

• 2-Bedroom, 2-Bathroom Apartment
• 6% Gross Rental Yield
• 5% Net Rental Yield
• Reserve from £2,500
• 15% on Exchange
• Strong Rental Demand
• Premium M1 Manchester Location
• Strong Long-Term Investment Potential
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Residents’ Lounge
• Co-Working Spaces
• Concierge Service
• Rooftop Garden

Secure Your Investment

Enquire today to secure your two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in M1, Manchester and receive a full investment pack, including pricing, payment terms, floor plans and projected returns.
